caption: The drawing depicts a single glass goblet centered on a plain, light beige background. The goblet is rendered in shades of purple and violet, giving the appearance of a translucent material. It has a wide, cylindrical bowl at the top, which is smooth and unadorned. Below the bowl, the surface transitions into a section with diagonal textured lines, followed by a prominent band of interlaced, diamond-shaped patterns encircling the goblet. The stem is short and quickly expands into a wide, circular base that maintains the same purple hue. There are no additional objects or decorations present in the drawing, and the composition focuses solely on the goblet, with ample empty space around it.
title: Salt Cellar
